title: Police Siren
blurb: Wail, yelp and the hi-lo: police sirens use different patterns for different situations, and every country's ear is tuned to its own set. That is half the comedy of dropping one into a video — an American whoop over a British street scene reads instantly as a joke, while the correct siren reads as genuine trouble. Thirteen seconds gives you room to pick a section. Online it functions mostly as a punishment sting, arriving the moment somebody says something they really should not have.
